نَاطِبةٌ , and نَاطِبٌ, sing. of نَوَاطِبُ in the following sense: (TA:) The holes that are made in a thing with which one clears, or clarifies, [i. e. strains, or filters], and through which what is cleared [or strained] passes forth: (K:) the holes of a strainer for wine, &c. (TA.) ―
-b2- See مِنْطَبٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
